'''Gaya''' was a [[gender|female]] [[human]] vendor who lived on [[Pabu]] in [[18 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]]'s stay, she was very friendly towards [[Batcher]]. When the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] occupied the island, Batcher defended Ms. Gaya when [[TK stormtrooper]]s tried to evict her and her family from their home.<ref name="PoNR" />
